## 2. Tool contracts (read-only; no SQL, Python, shell, file or ledger-execution tool)

| tool | arguments | returns | population labels |
|---|---|---|---|
| get_review_overview | none | Overview of this Monday review: every paid channel's current budget, readiness, failed stages and the deterministic policy action, plus sandbox ledger totals. | channel_review_status; sandbox_ledger_state |
| get_quality_checks | channel:string | The staged evidence gates for one channel (evidence binding, completeness, each quality check, forecast coverage, uncertainty, payback target) with pass/fail and what a failure blocks. | weekly_window_quality_checks |
| get_forecast_and_populations | channel:string | The weekly forecast for one channel's review window with its INCLUDED and EXCLUDED (withheld) cohorts reported separately, and the forecast interval. | channel_review_window; excluded_withheld_cohorts; included_cohorts; included_cohorts_weekly_forecast_interval |
| get_economics | channel:string | Average D30 ROAS (included cohorts), the payback target, the response curve and the MODEL-ESTIMATED finite-step marginal ROAS for one channel. | channel_economics; historical_spend_install_response; included_cohorts_forecast_average; included_cohorts_model_estimated_finite_step; mature_history_payback_target |
| get_policy_decision | channel:string | The deterministic policy action and proposed budget for one channel, with its reasons. | policy_decision |
| plan_experiment | channel:string, new_budget:number | Deterministically recalculate an increase to EXACTLY new_budget (model-estimated marginal ROAS and lower bound) and build its frozen experiment plan with the planning power study. Returns whether the step qualifies. Use it for every increase you consider, including a smaller step than the policy's. | experiment_plan_for_exact_step; frozen_experiment_plan_planning_study; model_estimated_step_recalculation |
| check_budget_constraints | changes:array | Check a set of proposed budget changes against the hard constraints (cap, floor, share, ceiling) and the exact inverse change. | hard_constraints_check |

Every successful call is wrapped in an envelope {tool_call_id, tool, args, channel, as_of, policy_hash, populations, result, output_sha256}. A claim must name (tool_call_id, field path in `result`, value, population, channel) and is checked against the stored envelope.
